glossary.Affinity: Affinity for a type of thing (such as artifacts) makes this spell cost {1} less for each of those things you control.
glossary.Basic landcycling: Pay the cost and discard this card from your hand to search your library for a basic land card, put it in your hand, then shuffle.
glossary.Bushido: Whenever this creature blocks or becomes blocked, it gets +N/+N until end of turn (N is the number after the word).
glossary.Cascade: When you cast this spell, exile cards from the top of your library until you hit a nonland card that costs less, and you may cast that card for free; the rest go on the bottom in a random order.
glossary.Channel: Channel lets you pay a cost and discard this card from your hand to get a special effect instead of casting it.
glossary.Constellation: Constellation abilities trigger whenever this permanent or another enchantment enters the battlefield under your control.
glossary.Convoke: Your creatures can help pay for this spell: each creature you tap while casting it pays for {1} or one mana of that creature's color.
glossary.Cycling: Pay the cycling cost and discard this card from your hand to draw a new card.
glossary.Deathtouch: Any amount of damage this deals to a creature, even 1, is enough to destroy it.
glossary.Defender: This creature can't attack, but it can still block.
glossary.Double: Some effects double a number, such as a creature's power, the +1/+1 counters on it, or the damage dealt to a player.
glossary.Double strike: This creature deals combat damage twice: once before creatures without first strike, and again at the normal time.
glossary.Enchant: Found on Auras, it says what the Aura can be attached to (such as a creature or a land); if that thing leaves the battlefield, the Aura goes to the graveyard.
glossary.Equip: Pay the equip cost to attach this Equipment to a creature you control, but only on your own turn when you could cast a sorcery.
glossary.Exert: You may exert this creature as it attacks to get a bonus, but then it won't untap during your next untap step.
glossary.Explore: Reveal the top card of your library: if it's a land, put it in your hand; if not, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature and either leave the card on top or put it into your graveyard.
glossary.Fight: When two creatures fight, each one deals damage equal to its power to the other.
glossary.First strike: This creature deals its combat damage before creatures without first strike, so it can often defeat an opponent before getting hit back.
glossary.Flash: You may cast this card any time you could cast an instant, even during your opponent's turn.
glossary.Flashback: You may cast this card from your graveyard by paying its flashback cost, and then it is exiled.
glossary.Flying: Can only be blocked by creatures with flying or reach.
glossary.Food: A Food is an artifact token you can pay {2}, tap, and sacrifice to gain 3 life.
glossary.For Mirrodin!: When this Equipment enters, create a 2/2 red Rebel creature token and attach the Equipment to it.
glossary.Haste: This creature can attack and use its tap abilities on the same turn it comes under your control.
glossary.Heroic: Heroic abilities trigger whenever you cast a spell that targets this creature.
glossary.Investigate: Create a Clue, an artifact token you can pay {2} and sacrifice to draw a card.
glossary.Kicker: You may pay an extra kicker cost as you cast this spell to get a bigger or additional effect.
glossary.Landcycling: Pay the cost and discard this card from your hand to search your library for a land card of the stated kind, put it in your hand, then shuffle.
glossary.Landfall: Landfall abilities trigger whenever a land enters the battlefield under your control.
glossary.Lifelink: Damage dealt by this creature also makes you gain that much life.
glossary.Madness: If you discard this card, you may cast it right away for its madness cost instead of just putting it into your graveyard.
glossary.Menace: This creature can't be blocked except by two or more creatures.
glossary.Mentor: Whenever this creature attacks, put a +1/+1 counter on another attacking creature you choose that has less power than it.
glossary.Mill: To mill a number of cards, put that many cards from the top of a library into its owner's graveyard.
glossary.Morbid: Morbid abilities get an extra effect if any creature died this turn.
glossary.Ninjutsu: Pay the ninjutsu cost and return one of your unblocked attacking creatures to your hand to put this card onto the battlefield tapped and attacking.
glossary.Pack tactics: Pack tactics abilities trigger when this creature attacks if the creatures you attacked with have a total power of 6 or more.
glossary.Protection: Protection from a quality (such as a color) means this can't be blocked, targeted, enchanted, or equipped by anything with that quality, and damage from those sources is prevented.
glossary.Prowess: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, this creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
glossary.Raid: Raid abilities give a bonus if you attacked with a creature earlier this turn.
glossary.Reach: This creature can block creatures with flying.
glossary.Scry: Look at the top N cards of your library, then put any of them on the bottom and the rest back on top in any order.
glossary.Support: Support N puts a +1/+1 counter on each of up to N other target creatures.
glossary.Surveil: Look at the top N cards of your library, then put any of them into your graveyard and the rest back on top in any order.
glossary.Trample: When this creature attacks and is blocked, any damage beyond what is needed to destroy its blockers can be dealt to the player or planeswalker it's attacking.
glossary.Treasure: A Treasure is an artifact token you can tap and sacrifice to add one mana of any color.
glossary.Typecycling: Like cycling, but instead of drawing you pay the cost and discard this card to search your library for a card of the named type, put it in your hand, then shuffle.
glossary.Undergrowth: Undergrowth abilities grow stronger with the number of creature cards in your graveyard.
glossary.Vigilance: Attacking doesn't cause this creature to tap, so it can still block on your opponent's turn.
glossary.Ward: Whenever this becomes the target of a spell or ability an opponent controls, that spell or ability is canceled unless they pay the ward cost.

5deb74ff-15df-4894-b074-9a98731bd2c0.n: Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose

themes.name: Angels
themes.description: A white flying pack built around Angels that grow each other as more of them land on the battlefield.
themes.plan: Get Giada or Youthful Valkyrie down early, then follow up with more Angels so each one arrives bigger, and win in the air while Pacifism handles a ground threat.

variants.note: Adds Serra Angel, with Destroy Evil and Light of Hope for flexible answers and Celestial Enforcer to tap blockers
Adds Herald of War and Stalwart Valkyrie, plus Rally of Wings for a big air swing and Angelic Edict as removal

themes.name: Armed
themes.description: A white equipment pack: small soldiers that pick up weapons and armor to become much bigger threats.
themes.plan: Play cheap creatures, suit them up, and attack; Danitha Capashen makes the gear cheaper and Fencing Ace gets double value from every bonus.

variants.note: Mace of the Valiant and Valkyrie's Sword, with Starnheim Courser to discount artifacts
Stone Haven Outfitter, Plate Armor and Hexgold Hoverwings, with Militant Inquisitor
Maul of the Skyclaves and Flutterfox for flying, plus Resistance Reunited and Trusty Retriever
Godsend and Plate Armor, with Thopter Architect for evasion and Deadly Riposte as removal

themes.name: Beasts
themes.description: A green pack of big Beasts that get cheaper, bigger and draw you cards as the herd grows.
themes.plan: Land Woodland Liege or Advocate of the Beast early, then cast Beasts that draw cards and grow; Slinza makes the rest cheaper and Time to Feed clears the way.

variants.note: Obstinate Baloth and Spined Tyrranax, with Explore and Gift of the Gargantuan to find lands and creatures
Garruk, Caller of Beasts and Garruk's Packleader for card draw, plus Baloth Gorger and Bushwhack

themes.name: Bloody
themes.description: A red Vampire pack that makes Blood tokens and turns discarding into an advantage.
themes.plan: Attack early and often, use Blood tokens to swap bad cards for new ones, and finish with haste threats and Soul Sear clearing the biggest blocker.

variants.note: Madness focus with Anje's Ravager, Incorrigible Youths and Abandon Reason
Markov Blademaster and Markov Enforcer, with Blood Hypnotist to stop blockers
Scion of Opulence and Markov Warlord, with Vampiric Fury and Blood Feud
Falkenrath Marauders flying in, plus Voldaren Ambusher and Neonate's Rush

themes.name: Bookworms
themes.description: A blue card-draw pack where creatures get stronger whenever you draw more than one card in a turn.
themes.plan: Keep drawing extra cards to grow your creatures and fill your hand, then let Syr Elenora become huge while Starlight Snare locks down a threat.

variants.note: Overflowing Insight, Trial of Knowledge with Cartouche of Knowledge, and Shore Keeper
Teferi's Ageless Insight to double draws, plus Muse Drake, Witching Well and Uncomfortable Chill
Sphinx of Enlightenment, Thopter Mechanic and Omen of the Sea
Nadir Kraken and Tolarian Kraken reward every draw, with Opt and Soul Read

themes.name: Burning
themes.description: A red burn pack full of damage spells and creatures that ping the opponent whenever you cast them.
themes.plan: Cast cheap burn to clear blockers and hit the opponent, letting Firebrand Archer and Chandra's Spitfire add extra damage; Rionya copies your best creature on a big spell turn.

themes.name: Chaos
themes.description: A five-color pack of cascade spells and mana fixing, where each big spell casts a free bonus spell.
themes.plan: Use Terramorphic Expanse, Ash Barrens, Druid of the Anima and Chromatic Lantern to fix your mana, then cascade into free spells for a big swing in value.

themes.name: Clerics
themes.description: A black Cleric pack that brings creatures back from the graveyard and gains life along the way.
themes.plan: Trade creatures freely, then use Bonecaller Cleric and Revoke Demise to bring your best ones back; Dark Bargain keeps the cards flowing.

variants.note: Taborax, Nullpriest of Oblivion and Eerie Soultender, with Agonizing Syphon
Taborax, Entomber Exarch and Elderfang Disciple for discard, plus Severed Strands
Vito drains on lifegain, and Dark Supplicant can fetch Scion of Darkness
Vito and Priest of Forgotten Gods, with Extinguish the Light and Stronghold Confessor

themes.name: Copied
themes.description: A red spells pack where instants and sorceries make tokens, pump creatures and get copied.
themes.plan: Fill the board with Young Pyromancer tokens and pump Kiln Fiend by casting cheap spells; target Zada with a pump spell to copy it onto your whole team.

variants.note: Cheap card-drawing spells like Crimson Wisps and Renegade Tactics, plus Guttersnipe and Spellgorger Weird
Two Ancestral Anger, Charmbreaker Devils and Uncaged Fury for double strike

themes.name: Dinner
themes.description: A green Food pack that makes Food tokens and spends them for life, cards and huge creatures.
themes.plan: Build up Food, then sacrifice it for a 7/7 Giant, a +5/+5 pump or extra cards from Trail of Crumbs; Hurska turns the life you gain into extra damage.

themes.name: Dinosaurs
themes.description: A green pack of big Dinosaurs with ramp spells to cast them early.
themes.plan: Ramp with Rampant Growth, find Dinosaurs with Commune with Dinosaurs, and stomp in with tramplers; enough power on the board makes Ghalta nearly free.

variants.note: Drover of the Mighty for mana, Armored Kincaller, Savage Stomp and Giant Growth
Topiary Stomper and Cherished Hatchling, with Tail Swipe and Predator's Strike

themes.name: Dragons
themes.description: A red flying pack of Dragons, with cost reducers and spells that get better when a Dragon is around.
themes.plan: Curve into Dragons in the air, use Dragonlord's Servant to cast them sooner, and land Lathliss so every new Dragon brings a 5/5 friend.

variants.note: Rapacious Dragon for Treasure, Carnelian Orb of Dragonkind for haste, and Bathe in Dragonfire
Sarkhan, Fireblood and Hellkite Whelp, with Sarkhan's Rage as a finisher

themes.name: Drowned
themes.description: A blue graveyard pack that mills cards and gets value from what lands there.
themes.plan: Fill your graveyard early with Wall of Lost Thoughts and Screaming Swarm, then cash in with Sudden Insight, flashback and Neerdiv's card draw.

variants.note: Shipwreck Dowser, Stitched Drake and Organ Hoarder, with Silent Departure and Ipnu Rivulet
Cackling Counterpart, Waker of Waves and Cruel Witness, with Towering-Wave Mystic

themes.name: Elves
themes.description: A green Elf pack that ramps mana and swarms the board with Elves that pump each other.
themes.plan: Use cheap mana Elves to go wide fast, then cast Overcome for a big trampling attack; Dionus grows your Elves each time they tap.

variants.note: Leaf-Crowned Visionary as the lord, plus Thornweald Archer and Band Together
Elvish Archdruid, Dwynen's Elite and Might of the Masses
Marwyn, the Nurturer and Llanowar Visionary for more mana
Tyvar Kell and Voice of the Woods, with Paradise Druid

themes.name: Enchanted
themes.description: A white enchantments pack where Auras and enchantment creatures trigger bonus effects as they enter.
themes.plan: Play an enchantment each turn to make Psemilla's Nymph tokens and give Flutterfox flying, with Banishing Light removing the biggest threat.

variants.note: Constellation tricks from Captivating Unicorn and Favored of Iroas, plus Spirited Companion
Cartouche of Solidarity, Cage of Hands and Nyx-Fleece Ram
Lifegain build with Nykthos Paragon, Serra's Embrace and Starfield Mystic
Archon of Sun's Grace makes flying Pegasi, with Angelic Gift and Favored of Iroas

themes.name: Encounter
themes.description: A green +1/+1 counters pack where creatures keep growing and many cards reward having counters.
themes.plan: Spread +1/+1 counters early, then let Mowu and counter-doubling effects turn your team into a trampling force; Jiang Yanggu makes counters into mana.

variants.note: Forgotten Ancient and Servant of the Scale, with Biogenic Upgrade and Duskshell Crawler
Oran-Rief Ooze and Jungle Delver, with Invigorating Surge and Stony Strength
Rishkar, Peema Renegade and Biogenic Upgrade, with Reckless Amplimancer
Primeval Bounty and Quirion Beastcaller, with Armorcraft Judge for cards

themes.name: Explorers
themes.description: A green Scout pack that searches for lands, explores and turns extra land drops into a bigger army.
themes.plan: Hit every land drop with Explore and Go Forth, then attack with Braulios, whose size equals your land count and who draws a card each time he swings.

variants.note: Realm Seekers and Tireless Provisioner, with Ainok Guide and Adventurous Impulse
Clue value from Tireless Tracker and Ulvenwald Mysteries, plus Primeval Herald
Tokens build with Somberwald Beastmaster, Briarbridge Tracker and Woodland Champion
Explore creatures: Jadelight Ranger, Merfolk Branchwalker and Ixalli's Diviner

themes.name: Fun Guys
themes.description: A green Fungus pack that floods the board with 1/1 Saproling tokens and pumps them all at once.
themes.plan: Make Saprolings with Saproling Migration and Spore Swarm, grow them with Sporecrown Thallid, and let Shroofus multiply any that connect.

variants.note: Overwhelm and Might of the Masses as finishers, plus Tukatongue Thallid and Spore Crawler
Verdeloth the Ancient and Undercellar Myconid, with Overcome and For the Family

themes.name: Ghastly
themes.description: A black pack that profits whenever creatures die, with sacrifice outlets and morbid rewards.
themes.plan: Trade creatures and sacrifice them on purpose to draw cards with Morbid Opportunist and drain with Falkenrath Noble, using Tragic Slip as cheap removal.

variants.note: Harvester of Souls, Murder and Wakedancer, with Village Rites
Bloodgift Demon, Gnawing Zombie and Typhoid Rats, with Defenestrate
Reaper from the Abyss and Morkrut Behemoth, with Deadly Dispute and Murder
Army of the Damned for a swarm of Zombies, plus Shambling Ghast and Crawl from the Cellar

themes.name: Giddyap
themes.description: A white pack of Unicorns, Pegasi and Horses with plenty of lifegain.
themes.plan: Fly over with Pegasi and gain life to grow Celestial Unicorn; Thurid copies each Unicorn, Pegasus and Horse you cast and pumps the rest.

themes.name: Goblins
themes.description: A red Goblin pack that makes lots of 1/1 tokens and gets damage from going wide.
themes.plan: Flood the board with Goblin tokens from Krenko's Command and Goblin Surprise, attack with General Kreat for more, and finish with Volley Veteran or a team pump.

variants.note: Dropkick Bomber and Battle Cry Goblin, with Goblin Researcher and Brute Strength
Goblin Goliath and Dropkick Bomber, with Goblin Arsonist and Mogg Flunkies
Krenko, Tin Street Kingpin and Beetleback Chief, with Scavenged Blade
Goblin Rabblemaster and Fanatical Firebrand, with Fire Prophecy

themes.name: Grave Robbers
themes.description: A black graveyard pack that mills its own deck to fuel creature recursion.
themes.plan: Mill early with Gorging Vulture, then bring creatures back over and over with Eternal Taskmaster and Revoke Demise until the opponent runs out of answers.

variants.note: Gorex, the Tombshell and Graveblade Marauder, with Grave Strength and Murder
Gorex, Doomed Necromancer and Dusk Mangler, with Necrotic Wound
Isareth the Awakener and Dreadhound, with Persistent Specimen and Memorial to Folly
Liliana, Death's Majesty and Isareth, with Goremand

themes.name: Healers
themes.description: A white lifegain pack where gaining life grows your creatures and powers up your Angels.
themes.plan: Gain a little life every turn to put counters on Ajani's Pridemate and Qala, then attack with a growing team while Angel of Vitality adds extra life.

variants.note: Speaker of the Heavens, Angel of Mercy and Faith's Fetters
Valkyrie Harbinger and Speakeasy Server, with Take Up the Shield
Righteous Valkyrie and Banisher Priest, with Angel of Mercy
Felidar Sovereign and Rhox Faithmender for a 40-life win, plus Faith's Fetters

themes.name: Heroes
themes.description: A white pack built around heroic creatures that grow stronger or gain extra effects whenever you target them with your own spells.
themes.plan: Play cheap heroic creatures early, then cast pump spells and auras on them so each spell also adds counters or triggers a bonus, building one or two big attackers.

variants.note: more combat tricks (Dauntless Onslaught, Moment of Heroism) plus Akroan Skyguard and Tethmos High Priest to bring back small creatures
more tempo: Ojutai Exemplars, Elite Skirmisher and Repel the Darkness tap down blockers, and Gird for Battle adds counters

themes.name: Icky
themes.description: A black pack of insects, worms and other creepy-crawlies that are happy to be sacrificed for value.
themes.plan: Make extra bodies with Wriggling Grub and Fumulus, then sacrifice them to pump Nantuko Husk or Devouring Swarm and to fuel removal like Eaten Alive.

variants.note: more aggressive: Fretwork Colony and Swarm of Bloodflies grow, Village Rites turns a sacrifice into cards, Durable Coilbug comes back
grindier: Endless Cockroaches returns to hand, Virus Beetle forces a discard, plus Torment of Scarabs and Morkrut Necropod

themes.name: Illusions
themes.description: A blue pack of Illusion creatures that are cheap and evasive but often fragile, backed by a lord that makes them stronger and hard to target.
themes.plan: Land Lord of the Unreal to make your Illusions bigger and hexproof, then fly or slip past blockers while instants and sorceries make more Bird Illusions with Murmuring Mystic.

themes.name: Inventive
themes.description: A blue artifact pack full of Thopters, Constructs and gadgets that reward you for keeping lots of artifacts on the battlefield.
themes.plan: Fill the board with cheap artifacts and Thopter tokens, pump them with Chief of the Foundry, and use the artifact count to discount or power up your bigger threats.

variants.note: Thopter engine: Sai, Master Thopterist and Whirlermaker, plus Filigree Attendant, Gearseeker Serpent and bounce from Blink of an Eye
Sai and Shimmer Dragon lead, with Fireshrieker, Treasure Keeper, Malfunction and Universal Solvent
affinity payoffs: Thought Monitor, Thoughtcast and Myr Enforcer get cheap, with Padeem and Patchwork Automaton
Padeem protects your artifacts, with Treasure Keeper, Guardian Idol, Shardless Outlander and Blink of an Eye

themes.name: Landfall
themes.description: A green pack whose creatures get bigger or trigger bonuses every time a land enters the battlefield under your control.
themes.plan: Make your land drop every turn (Evolving Wilds and Sutina give extra drops) and attack with landfall creatures while they are pumped, using Bite Down to clear blockers.

variants.note: ramp and power: Lotus Cobra, Harrow, Undergrowth Champion, Baloth Woodcrasher and Skyclave Pick-Axe
value and life gain: Ancient Greenwarden, Retreat to Kazandu, Kazandu Nectarpot, Territorial Scythecat and Krosan Tusker
+1/+1 counters: Scythecat Cub, Territorial Scythecat, Murasa Ranger and Retreat to Kazandu, plus Cliffhaven Kitesail for flying
Scythecat Cub and Baloth Woodcrasher, with Sporemound tokens, Groundswell, Grazing Gladehart and Skyclave Pick-Axe

themes.name: Legion
themes.description: A white go-wide pack that floods the board with small Human and Soldier tokens.
themes.plan: Make lots of creatures with Raise the Alarm, Ancestral Blade and Adeline, then pump the whole team with Dauntless Unity or Dawnwing Marshal for a big swing.

variants.note: Make a Stand for a protected alpha strike, plus Argivian Phalanx, Search Party Captain and Pacifism
convoke: Triplicate Spirits, Venerated Loxodon and Conclave Tribunal, plus Defend the Campus and Memorial to Glory

themes.name: Modified
themes.description: A green pack about modified creatures: ones carrying +1/+1 counters, Auras or Equipment.
themes.plan: Put counters, Auras and Equipment on your creatures to unlock bonuses like trample and extra mana, then push damage through with Kodama of the West Tree ramping you each hit.

themes.name: Ne'er-do-wells
themes.description: A black pack of Rogues and thieves that sneak in attacks, draw cards and pocket Treasure.
themes.plan: Make an attacker hard to block with Thieves' Tools, give deathtouch with Rev, and turn hits into cards and Treasure while black removal clears the way.

variants.note: more removal: Murder and Serpent Assassin, plus Midnight Assassin and Pilfering Imp in the air
Rogue and mill focus: Thieves' Guild Enforcer, Expedition Skulker and Balustrade Spy, with Grim Bounty and Bloodtithe Collector

themes.name: Nefarious
themes.description: A black pack that trades your own life total for cards, removal and power.
themes.plan: Pay life freely with Dark Confidant, Read the Bones and Infernal Grasp to stay ahead on cards, then cash it in with Vilis drawing cards and Vampire Scrivener growing.

themes.name: Ninjas
themes.description: A blue pack of cheap, sneaky attackers and Ninjas that swap in when an attack goes unblocked.
themes.plan: Attack with small evasive creatures, then use ninjutsu to trade an unblocked one for a Ninja that draws cards or bounces a blocker, and replay the returned creature.

themes.name: Of the Coast
themes.description: A blue pack of crabs, starfish and turtles: sturdy, high-toughness creatures that hold the shore.
themes.plan: Stall the ground with tough blockers and tap down threats, draw a fistful with Plagon, then win by having creatures deal damage equal to their toughness.

variants.note: Kapsho Kitefins taps creatures, plus Omen of the Sea, Purple-Crystal Crab and Yarok's Wavecrasher to reuse enter effects
more flyers and spells: Azure Drake, Glimmerbell, Opt and Shipwreck Dowser

themes.name: Prideful
themes.description: A white Cat pack of efficient, aggressive creatures and a pair of Cat lords.
themes.plan: Curve out with cheap Cats, pump them with King of the Pride and Leonin Scimitar, and keep attacking while Brimaz adds tokens and removal handles blockers.

themes.name: Snakes
themes.description: A black pack of Snakes and Gorgons where nearly everything has deathtouch.
themes.plan: Make every combat bad for your opponent with deathtouch creatures and tricks, drain with Hooded Blightfang on each attack, and pick off damaged creatures with Vraska's Finisher.

themes.name: Soaring
themes.description: A blue flying pack of Drakes, Birds and Faeries that rewards attacking through the air.
themes.plan: Get several flyers out, pump them with Cynette, and draw extra cards with Tide Skimmer each time you attack with two or more.

variants.note: Windreader Sphinx and Warden of Evos Isle, with Waterkin Shaman, Winged Words, Gust of Wind and Uncomfortable Chill
Cavalier of Gales, Cartouche of Knowledge with Trial of Knowledge, Owl Familiar and Majestic Metamorphosis
Mu Yanling planeswalker, Windstorm Drake, Cloudkin Seer, Malcator's Watcher and Thopter Mechanic
Faeries: Sprite Noble and Stolen by the Fae, plus Air Elemental, Faerie Seer and Nightveil Sprite

themes.name: Stalwart
themes.description: A white +1/+1 counters pack whose creatures spread counters around and reward the ones that carry them.
themes.plan: Put counters on your creatures early, use Urdnan to give countered attackers first strike, and remove blockers with Banishing Light and Swift Response.

variants.note: Ajani, Adversary of Tyrants and Generous Pup, with Angelic Cub, Gavony Silversmith, Patron of the Valiant and Squad Captain
Basri's Lieutenant and Basri's Solidarity, with Star Pupil, Lightwalker, Battlefield Promotion and Cave of Temptation
support: Relief Captain, Expedition Raptor, Jubilant Mascot and Shoulder to Shoulder, plus Generous Pup
mentor and team counters: Light of the Legion, Mikaeus, the Lunarch, Parhelion Patrol and Sunhome Stalwart

themes.name: Stoked
themes.description: A red pack of heroic attackers and cheap spells that target your own creatures.
themes.plan: Pump a heroic creature like Cleon or Arena Athlete with Hearts on Fire and friends to stop blockers and add damage, using Roil Eruption to clear the way or finish the game.

variants.note: Frontline Heroism copies pump spells, plus Twinferno, Uncaged Fury, Kiln Fiend and Scholar of Combustion
Dreadhorde Arcanist recasts spells, plus Hero of the Games, Unleash Fury, Coordinated Assault and Kiln Fiend
Mirrorwing Dragon and Young Pyromancer, with Frontline Heroism, Akroan Crusader and Twinferno
Goblin Dark-Dwellers and Weaver of Lightning, with Young Pyromancer, Infuriate and Crimson Wisps

themes.name: Surprise!
themes.description: A blue flash pack that does most of its work at instant speed, during your opponent's turn.
themes.plan: Hold mana up, then flash in creatures and Auras as blockers or at end of turn, growing Brineborn Cutthroat and triggering Stinging Lionfish while you play off-turn.

variants.note: Thryx, the Sudden Storm, with Chrome Prowler, Capture Sphere, Slimebind, Crystacean and Wind Strider
Voracious Greatshark counters a creature, plus Thryx, Pestermite, Naiad of Hidden Coves and Starlit Mantle
Venser, Shaper Savant and Supreme Will, plus Pestermite, Breaching Hippocamp and Naiad of Hidden Coves
Venser and Wavebreak Hippocamp, with Soul Read, Vexing Gull and Aven Reedstalker

themes.name: Too Many
themes.description: A red pack about having more than you should: Goblin tokens, paired legends and doubled damage.
themes.plan: Flood the board with Goblin tokens and cheap attackers, then turn it into lethal with Goblin Surprise, burn and Fiendish Duo doubling the damage your opponent takes.

themes.name: Treasures
themes.description: A black sacrifice pack where creatures dying turns into Treasure tokens, cards and life drain.
themes.plan: Trade off and sacrifice creatures to Pitiless Plunderer, Ruthless Knave and Deadly Dispute, using the Treasure to ramp, draw and recast Reassembling Skeleton.

variants.note: Bastion of Remembrance drains on each death, with Ruthless Technomancer and Grim Bounty
harder removal: Contract Killing, Powerstone Fracture and Dusk Mangler, plus Vault of Whispers

themes.name: Vampires
themes.description: A black Vampire pack that drains life, gains it back and makes Blood tokens to filter cards.
themes.plan: Gain life a little at a time with lifelink Vampires, use it to fuel Nazar's card draw, and grind out the board with Bleed Dry and Blood Fountain.

variants.note: Sangromancer and Bloodtithe Collector, with Skymarch Bloodletter, Gift of Fangs, Urge to Feed and Vampire of the Dire Moon
Crossway Troublemakers and Sanctum Seeker, with Bloodthirsty Aerialist, Creeping Bloodsucker and Urge to Feed
Necropolis Regent and Thirsting Bloodlord, with Vicious Conquistador, Gift of Fangs and Go for the Throat
Vampire Nighthawk and Rodolf Duskbringer, with Exsanguinate, Epicure of Blood and Moment of Craving

themes.name: Warriors
themes.description: A red Warrior pack that turns opposing creatures into Cowards that cannot block.
themes.plan: Attack every turn with Warriors while Gornog and Goma Fada Vanguard shut down blockers, and burn the rest away with Soul Sear and Pyrophobia.

variants.note: Expedition Champion, Kruin Striker and Boggart Brute, with Kindled Fury
Kargan Intimidator and Daybreak Combatants, with Unstoppable Ogre and Infuriate

themes.name: Wizards
themes.description: A blue Wizard pack of creatures with useful enter-the-battlefield effects, led by Naban, who doubles them.
themes.plan: Play Wizards for card draw, bounce and tap effects, doubling them with Naban, and protect your lead with Remand and Starlight Snare.

variants.note: Archaeomancer and Exclusion Mage, with Cloudkin Seer, Concentrate, Choking Tethers and Windcaller Aven
Aether Channeler and Frost Trickster, with Expedition Diviner, Chilling Trap, Opportunity and Shipwreck Dowser

themes.name: Zealots
themes.description: A red exert pack of Minotaurs and Jackals that push extra hard on the attack in exchange for skipping their next untap.
themes.plan: Exert attackers to make them bigger or stop blockers, refill with Anep and Battlefield Scavenger, and finish with Fling or Trial of Zeal.

variants.note: Zealous Conscripts and Ahn-Crop Crasher, with Emberhorn Minotaur, Nef-Crop Entangler, Brute Strength and Flame-Blessed Bolt
Sandstorm Crasher and Ahn-Crop Crasher, with Zealot of the God-Pharaoh and Pathmaker Initiate
Combat Celebrant for extra combats, with Trueheart Twins, Emberhorn Minotaur, Shock and Hearts on Fire
Sandstorm Crasher and Zealous Conscripts, with Trueheart Twins, Minotaur Sureshot and Kindled Fury

themes.name: Elves
themes.description: A green pack of elves that work best together. Many of its elves make each other stronger or produce extra mana, which is the energy you spend to cast cards.
themes.plan: Play a cheap elf on your first or second turn so you have extra mana sooner, then build a crowd of elves with Elvish Archdruid making them bigger. Once you have a wide board, cast Joraga Invocation to give everyone +3/+3 and attack together.

themes.name: Goblins
themes.description: A red pack of fast, scrappy goblins. It plays lots of small creatures and makes them hit harder when they attack together.
themes.plan: Attack early and often: get several goblins out, use Goblin Oriflamme and Dropkick Bomber to make them stronger, and use Frenzied Goblin or Goblin Smuggler to keep your opponent's creatures from blocking. Save Incinerating Blast for the one big creature standing in your way.

themes.name: Healing
themes.description: A white pack of angels and protectors that gain life over and over. Several of its creatures grow stronger every time you gain life.
themes.plan: Play creatures like Ajani's Pridemate and Twinblade Paladin first, then add creatures that gain you life when they arrive or attack, so your growing creatures get a +1/+1 counter each time. Fly over blockers with your angels and Ancestor Dragon while your high life total keeps you safe.

themes.name: Inferno
themes.description: A red pack of dragons and fire spells. It burns away the opponent's creatures and builds up to huge flying dragons late in the game.
themes.plan: Use your burn spells to clear blockers while Dragonlord's Servant and Carnelian Orb of Dragonkind help you cast dragons sooner. Finish with Rapacious Dragon or Terror of Mount Velus, which gives your whole team double strike so every creature deals its damage twice.

themes.name: Pirates
themes.description: A blue pack of sneaky pirates that strike by surprise. It uses flash (casting a card on the opponent's turn), sends creatures back to their owner's hand, and rewards you for attacking.
themes.plan: Keep mana open on your opponent's turn so you can cast Spectral Sailor or Brineborn Cutthroat by surprise, or Cancel their spell. Attack first, then play Storm Fleet Spy or Skyship Buccaneer after combat to draw an extra card, and use Corsair Captain to make your other pirates stronger.

themes.name: Primal
themes.description: A green pack of big beasts that keep growing. It adds +1/+1 counters to its creatures, which make them permanently bigger, and gives them trample so extra damage gets through blockers.
themes.plan: Use Druid of the Cowl and New Horizons to get extra mana, then play larger creatures and grow them with counters and Giant Growth. Land Aggressive Mammoth to give your whole team trample, and use Bite Down to have your biggest creature knock out an enemy.

themes.name: Undead
themes.description: A black pack of zombies and skeletons that refuse to stay dead. Its creatures come back from the graveyard (your discard pile) or leave more zombies behind when they die.
themes.plan: Trade creatures freely in combat, because Reassembling Skeleton, Cemetery Recruitment, and Maalfeld Twins bring the army back. Play Death Baron to make your zombies and skeletons bigger and give them deathtouch, so even a small one destroys any creature it damages.

themes.name: Wizards
themes.description: A blue pack of clever wizards that draw lots of extra cards. Its creatures get stronger or make flying helpers when you draw more than one card in a turn.
themes.plan: Draw extra cards with Fleeting Distraction, Quick Study, and Arcane Epiphany to power up Clinquant Skymage and Mischievous Mystic. Slow your opponent down by sending their creatures back to their hand with Exclusion Mage and Into the Roil, or lock one down with Starlight Snare, while your fliers attack.
